lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਕੈਸੇ ਉਤਰਸਿ ਪਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam kee gat nahee jaanee kaise utaras paaraa ||1||
lines.translation: You do not know the exalted state of the Lord's Name; how will you ever cross over? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਬਧਹੁ ਸੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਪਹੁ ਅਧਰਮੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਤ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jee badhahu s dharam kar thaapahu adharam kahahu kat bhaaee ||
lines.translation: You kill living beings, and call it a righteous action. Tell me, brother, what would you call an unrighteous action?

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਮੁਨਿਵਰ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਪਹੁ ਕਾ ਕਉ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਸਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aapas kau munivar kar thaapahu kaa kau kahahu kasaaee ||2||
lines.translation: You call yourself the most excellent sage; then who would you call a butcher? ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕੇ ਅੰਧੇ ਆਪਿ ਨ ਬੂਝਹੁ ਕਾਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਵਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: man ke a(n)dhe aap na boojhahu kaahi bujhaavahu bhaaee ||
lines.translation: You are blind in your mind, and do not understand your own self; how can you make others understand, O brother?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਨ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਬੇਚਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa kaaran bidiaa bechahu janam abirathaa jaaee ||3||
lines.translation: For the sake of Maya and money, you sell knowledge; your life is totally worthless. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਰਦ ਬਚਨ ਬਿਆਸੁ ਕਹਤ ਹੈ ਸੁਕ ਕਉ ਪੂਛਹੁ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naarad bachan biaas kahat hai suk kau poochhahu jaaee ||
lines.translation: Naarad and Vyaasa say these things; go and ask Suk Dayv as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮੈ ਰਮਿ ਛੂਟਹੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਤ ਬੂਡੇ ਭਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer raamai ram chhootahu naahi ta boode bhaaee ||4||1||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, chanting the Lord's Name, you shall be saved; otherwise, you shall drown, brother. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਨਹਿ ਬਸੇ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਉ ਲਉ ਮਨਹੁ ਨ ਤਜਹਿ ਬਿਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: banahi base kiu paaeeai jau lau manahu na tajahi bikaar ||
lines.translation: Living in the forest, how will you find Him? Not until you remove corruption from your mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹ ਘਰੁ ਬਨੁ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਤੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jih ghar ban samasar keeaa te poore sa(n)saar ||1||
lines.translation: Those who look alike upon home and forest, are the most perfect people in the world. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਰਾਮਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: saar sukh paaeeai raamaa ||
lines.translation: You shall find real peace in the Lord,

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਵਹੁ ਆਤਮੈ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ra(n)g ravahu aatamai raam ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: if you lovingly dwell on the Lord within your being. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਟਾ ਭਸਮ ਲੇਪਨ ਕੀਆ ਕਹਾ ਗੁਫਾ ਮਹਿ ਬਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jataa bhasam lepan keeaa kahaa guphaa mahi baas ||
lines.translation: What is the use of wearing matted hair, smearing the body with ashes, and living in a cave?

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਜੀਤੇ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤਿਆ ਜਾਂ ਤੇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: man jeete jag jeetiaa jaa(n) te bikhiaa te hoi udaas ||2||
lines.translation: Conquering the mind, one conquers the world, and then remains detached from corruption. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਜਨੁ ਦੇਇ ਸਭੈ ਕੋਈ ਟੁਕੁ ਚਾਹਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਬਿਡਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)jan dei sabhai koee tuk chaahan maahi bidaan ||
lines.translation: They all apply make-up to their eyes; there is little difference between their objectives.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨੁ ਜਿਹ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਲੋਇਨ ਪਰਵਾਨੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: giaan a(n)jan jih paaiaa te loin paravaan ||3||
lines.translation: But those eyes, to which the ointment of spiritual wisdom is applied, are approved and supreme. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਅਬ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਦੀਆ ਸਮਝਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahi kabeer ab jaaniaa gur giaan deeaa samajhaai ||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, now I know my Lord; the Guru has blessed me with spiritual wisdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟਿਆ ਅਬ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਕਤਹੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)taragat har bhetiaa ab meraa man katahoo na jaai ||4||2||
lines.translation: I have met the Lord, and I am emancipated within; now, my mind does not wander at all. ||4||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਿਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਫੁਰੀ ਤਬ ਕਾਹੂ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਆ ਕਾਜ ॥
lines.transliteration: ridh sidh jaa kau phuree tab kaahoo siu kiaa kaaj ||
lines.translation: You have riches and miraculous spiritual powers; so what business do you have with anyone else?

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਕਹਨੇ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਕਿਆ ਕਹਉ ਮੈ ਬੋਲਤ ਹੀ ਬਡ ਲਾਜ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tere kahane kee gat kiaa kahau mai bolat hee bad laaj ||1||
lines.translation: What should I say about the reality of your talk? I am embarrassed even to speak to you. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮੁ ਜਿਹ ਪਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam jih paaiaa raam ||
lines.translation: One who has found the Lord,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇ ਭਵਹਿ ਨ ਬਾਰੈ ਬਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: te bhavahi na baarai baar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: does not wander from door to door. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਝੂਠਾ ਜਗੁ ਡਹਕੈ ਘਨਾ ਦਿਨ ਦੁਇ ਬਰਤਨ ਕੀ ਆਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: jhoothaa jag dahakai ghanaa din dui baratan kee aas ||
lines.translation: The false world wanders all around, in hopes of finding wealth to use for a few days.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਉਦਕੁ ਜਿਹ ਜਨ ਪੀਆ ਤਿਹਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਭਈ ਪਿਆਸ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: raam udak jih jan peeaa tihi bahur na bhaee piaas ||2||
lines.translation: That humble being, who drinks in the Lord's water, never becomes thirsty again. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਜਿਹ ਬੂਝਿਆ ਆਸਾ ਤੇ ਭਇਆ ਨਿਰਾਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur prasaad jih boojhiaa aasaa te bhaiaa niraas ||
lines.translation: Whoever understands, by Guru's Grace, becomes free of hope in the midst of hope.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਦਰੀ ਆਇਆ ਜਉ ਆਤਮ ਭਇਆ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: sabh sach nadaree aaiaa jau aatam bhaiaa udaas ||3||
lines.translation: One comes to see the Lord everywhere, when the soul becomes detached. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰ ਤਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam ras chaakhiaa har naamaa har taar ||
lines.translation: I have tasted the sublime essence of the Lord's Name; the Lord's Name carries everyone across.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਗਇਆ ਸਮੁਦ੍ਰੈ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੪॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: kahu kabeer ka(n)chan bhaiaa bhram gaiaa samudrai paar ||4||3||
lines.translation: Says Kabeer, I have become like gold; doubt is dispelled, and I have crossed over the world-ocean. ||4||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਦਕ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਸਲਲ ਕੀ ਸਾਖਿਆ ਨਦੀ ਤਰੰਗ ਸਮਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: udak samu(n)d salal kee saakhiaa nadee tara(n)g samaavahige ||
lines.translation: Like drops of water in the water of the ocean, and like waves in the stream, I merge in the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨਹਿ ਸੁੰਨੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਪਵਨ ਰੂਪ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: su(n)nahi su(n)n miliaa samadarasee pavan roop hoi jaavahige ||1||
lines.translation: Merging my being into the Absolute Being of God, I have become impartial and transparent, like the air. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਹਮ ਕਾਹੇ ਆਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahur ham kaahe aavahige ||
lines.translation: Why should I come into the world again?

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੁਝਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavan jaanaa hukam tisai kaa hukamai bujh samaavahige ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Coming and going is by the Hukam of His Command; realizing His Hukam, I shall merge in Him. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਬ ਚੂਕੈ ਪੰਚ ਧਾਤੁ ਕੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਐਸੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jab chookai pa(n)ch dhaat kee rachanaa aise bharam chukaavahige ||
lines.translation: When the body, formed of the five elements, perishes, then any such doubts shall end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਭਏ ਸਮਦਰਸੀ ਏਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿਗੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: darasan chhod bhae samadarasee eko naam dhiaavahige ||2||
lines.translation: Giving up the different schools of philosophy, I look upon all equally; I meditate only on the One Name. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤ ਹਮ ਲਾਏ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਤੈਸੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit ham laae tit hee laage taise karam kamaavahige ||
lines.translation: Whatever I am attached to, to that I am attached; such are the deeds I do.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਉ ਅਪਨੀ ਤੌ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: har jee kripaa kare jau apanee tau gur ke sabad samaavahige ||3||
lines.translation: When the Dear Lord grants His Grace, then I am merged in the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰਹੁ ਮਰਹੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਜੀਵਹੁ ਪੁਨਰਪਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeevat marahu marahu phun jeevahu punarap janam na hoee ||
lines.translation: Die while yet alive, and by so dying, be alive; thus you shall not be reborn again.
